title: Amazon Bedrock streaming with AWS AppSync
description: Stream Amazon Bedrock responses with AWS AppSync

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an AWS AppSync API along with an AWS Lambda function. The API exposes a mutation that asynchronously invokes the Lambda function (thus bypassing the 30s timeout of AppSync) that calls Anthropic Claude V3 Haiku through Amazon Bedrock and streams the response back to the end user through an AppSync subscription.
See the Github repo for detailed testing instructions.
